annotations.title: Observer went quiet
annotations.summary: This observer has not checked in for 1m 35s (it normally checks in every 15 seconds).
annotations.impact: Competing blocks it would have seen are not being recorded. The other observers keep working.
annotations.action: Check its collector: systemctl status cipherscan-orphan-collector (or the remote collector for partner nodes).
